Method of Attack: Banking Trojan with keylogger and screenshot capabilities to steal banking credentials
Uses motion sensors to detect malware analysis sandboxes and evade detection
Uses fake system update screen to trick users into granting administrator privileges
Malware dropper contacts C&C server via Twitter or Telegram requests and HTTP POST to download and install APK
Additional functionalities include ransomware (encrypting files with .Anubiscrypt extension), RAT features (sound recording, location tracking), SMS spam sending, and calling premium numbers
Impacted Systems: 377 different bank applications from 93 countries including Santander, RBS, Natwest, Citibank
Non-banking apps such as Amazon, eBay, PayPal
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps (Currency Converter and BatterySaverMobi) distributed via Google Play Store
Malware dropper installed via fake system update screen trick
Command and Control server communication via Twitter, Telegram, and HTTP POST
Indicators of Compromise: Command and Control server domain: aserogeege.space
APK download links sent by C&C server
File extension .Anubiscrypt for ransomware encrypted files
